meanings.usage: 强调时间观念的重要性

meanings.meaning: 守时（指按时到达或完成某事的习惯） noun. 准时性

meanings.usage: 指社会发展到较高阶段

meanings.meaning: 有教养的（形容社会或个人具有良好行为规范） adj. 开化的

meanings.usage: 指对困难或不适的承受程度

meanings.meaning: 容忍（指对不同意见或行为的宽恕态度） noun. 忍耐力

meanings.usage: 形容复杂难理解的事物，常用于学术或科学问题
形容工作努力、认真的人

meanings.meaning: 令人讨厌的人/事物（指造成麻烦或不便的人或事） noun. 损害
meanings.usage: 法律用语中指侵害行为

meanings.meaning: 少量（指整体中的一小部分） noun. 分数

meanings.usage: 指旅行时携带的箱包等物品

meanings.meaning: 挥舞（指引人注意的戏剧性动作） verb. 繁荣

meanings.usage: 形容非常小以至于难以察觉的事物
指旅行或运输的最终目的地
本意，指在表面上压出图案

meanings.meaning: 使铭记（强调某事在某人心中的深刻印象） verb. 印

meanings.usage: 指在车站、机场等帮人搬行李的人
形容态度坚决，不愿改变主意

phrases.usage: 使结束；得出结论，指完成某事或做出决定

examples.en: Only in this way can we bring the matter to a conclusion.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能结束这件事。

phrases.usage: 处于混乱状态，形容无秩序、混乱的局面

examples.en: Without rules, everything would be in a state of chaos.
examples.zh: 没有规则，一切都会陷入混乱。

phrases.usage: 把时间扣得很紧，指在最后时刻才完成任务或到达

examples.en: He always cuts things fine when catching trains.
examples.zh: 他赶火车时总是把时间扣得很紧。

phrases.usage: 出发；动身，指开始旅程或着手做某事

examples.en: They set out for the station early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就出发去车站了。

phrases.usage: 使深刻印象；叮嘱，强调某事的重要性让某人记住

examples.en: Her parents impressed upon her that punctuality was important.
examples.zh: 她的父母让她深刻记住准时的重要性。

phrases.usage: 指出；指明，用于提示或解释某事

examples.en: The station master pointed out the mistake on the timetable.
examples.zh: 站长指出时刻表上的错误。

phrases.usage: 溜进；悄悄进入，指不引人注意地进入某处

examples.en: She tried to slip into the train before it left.
examples.zh: 她试图在火车开走前溜进去。

phrases.usage: 使她恐惧的是，用于引出令人害怕或震惊的情况

examples.en: To her horror, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 使她恐惧的是，火车已经开走了。

phrases.usage: 和...一样（用于比较），强调两者在某方面程度相同

examples.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial as the unpunctual.
examples.zh: 过于准时的人和不准时的人一样让人头疼。

phrases.usage: 不可原谅的，指错误严重到无法被原谅

examples.en: It would be unforgivable to miss the train.
examples.zh: 错过这班火车将是不可原谅的。

grammar.title: 条件句 (If引导的真实条件句)
grammar.structure: If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will/won't + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示真实可能发生的情况，使用if引导的条件状语从句 用于讨论可能发生的真实情况，提出假设或条件

examples.en: If no accidents occur on the way, they will be on time.
examples.zh: 如果路上没有事故，他们会准时到达。

examples.en: If you are catching a train, it is better to be early.
examples.zh: 如果你要赶火车，最好早一点。

grammar.title: Only + 状语 置于句首的倒装
grammar.structure: Only + 状语 + be/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 其他
grammar.definition: 当only置于句首修饰状语时，句子需要部分倒装 强调条件或方式，突出唯一性

examples.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard punctuality.
examples.zh: 只有在人口稀少的农村社区才可能忽视守时。

examples.en: Only then did she realize her mistake.
examples.zh: 直到那时她才意识到自己的错误。

grammar.title: too...to... 结构
grammar.structure: too + 形容词/副词 + (for sb.) + to do sth.
grammar.definition: 表示太...以至于不能...，too后接形容词，to后接动词原形 表达程度过高导致不可能实现的情况

examples.en: She was two hours too early.
It is too difficult for a child to understand.
examples.zh: 这对一个孩子来说太难理解了。

patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.

original.en: It is hard for energetic, quick-minded people to waste time.
original.zh: 对于精力充沛、思维敏捷的人来说，浪费时间是很困难的。

imitations.en: It is necessary for us to be punctual.
imitations.zh: 对我们来说守时是必要的。

imitations.en: It is important for students to practice English every day.
imitations.zh: 对学生来说每天练习英语是重要的。

patterns.pattern: Only in + 地点/时间 + is it possible to...

original.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it.
original.zh: 只有在人口稀少的农村社区才可能忽视它。

imitations.en: Only in this way can we solve the problem.
imitations.zh: 只有用这种方法我们才能解决问题。

imitations.en: Only in Beijing can you see such historical sites.
imitations.zh: 只有在北京你才能看到这样的历史遗迹。

patterns.pattern: The + adj. + can be as much...as...

original.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual.
original.zh: 过于准时的人和不准时的人一样让人头疼。

imitations.en: The rich can be as unhappy as the poor.
imitations.zh: 富人和穷人一样可能不快乐。

imitations.en: Being early can be as bad as being late.
imitations.zh: 来得太早和迟到一样糟糕。

patterns.pattern: It would be + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: It would be unforgivable to miss it.
original.zh: 错过它将是不可原谅的。

imitations.en: It would be foolish to give up now.
It would be wise to arrive early.

lines.en: Punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society.
lines.zh: 准时是文明社会中进行一切社交活动时必须养成的习惯。

lines.en: Without it, nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion; everything would be in state of chaos .
lines.zh: 不准时将一事无成，事事都会陷入混乱不堪的境地。

lines.en: Only in a sparsely -populated rural community is it possible to disregard it.
lines.zh: 只有在人口稀少的农村，才可以忽视准时的习惯。

lines.en: In ordinary living, there can be some tolerance of unpunctuality.
lines.zh: 在日常生活中人们可以容忍一定程度的不准时。

lines.en: The intellectual, who is working on some abstruse problem, has everything coordinated and organized for the matter in hand.
lines.zh: 一个专心钻研某个复杂问题的知识分子，为了搞好手头的研究，要把一切都协调一致，组织周密。

lines.en: He is therefore forgiven if late for a dinner party.
lines.zh: 因此，他要是赴宴迟到了会得到谅解。

lines.en: But people are often reproached for unpunctuality when their only fault is cutting things fine.
lines.zh: 但有些人不准时常常因为掐钟点所致，他们常常受到责备，精力充沛、头脑敏捷的人极不愿意浪费时间，因此他们常想做完一件事后再去赴约。

lines.en: It is hard for energetic, quick-minded people to waste time, so they are often tempted to finish a job before setting out to keep an appointment.
lines.zh: 要是路上没有发生如爆胎、改道、突然起雾等意外事故，他们决不会迟到。

lines.en: If no accidents occur on the way, like punctured tires, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time.
lines.zh: 他们与那些从不迟到的人相比，常常是更勤奋有用的公民。

lines.en: They are often more industrious , useful citizens than those who are never late.
lines.zh: 早到的人同迟到的人一样令人讨厌。

lines.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual.
lines.zh: 客人提前半小时到达是令人讨厌的。

lines.en: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance.
lines.zh: 我家有几个朋友就有这有令人恼火的习惯。

lines.en: Some friends of my family had this irritating habit.
lines.zh: 唯一的办法就是请他们比别的客人晚来半小时。

lines.en: The only thing to do was ask them to come half an hour later than the other guests.
lines.zh: 这样，他们可以恰好在我们要求的时间到达。

lines.en: Then they arrived just when we wanted them.
lines.zh: 如果赶火车，早到总比晚到好，哪怕早到一会儿也好。

lines.en: If you are citing a train, it is always better to be comfortably early than even a fraction of a minted too late.
lines.zh: 虽然早到可能意味着浪费一点时间，但这比误了火车等上一个多小时坐下班车浪费的时间要少，而且可以避免那种正好在火车驶出站时赶到车站，因上不去车而感到的沮丧。

lines.en: Although being early may mean wasting a little time, this will be less than if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one; and you avoid the frustration of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get on it.
lines.zh: 更难堪的情况是虽然及时赶到站台上，却眼睁睁地看着那趟火车启动，把你抛下。

lines.en: An even harder situation is to be on the platform in good time for a train and still to see it go off without you.
lines.zh: 一个小姑娘第一次单独出门就碰到了这种情况。

lines.en: Such an experience befell a certain young girl the first time she was traveling alone.
lines.zh: 在火车进站20分钟前她就进了车站。

lines.en: She entered the station twenty minutes before the train was due, since her parents had impressed upon her that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her.
lines.zh: 因为她的父母再三跟她说，如果误了这趟车，她的东道主朋友就得接她两趟，这是不应该的。

lines.en: She gave her luggage to a porter and showed him her ticket.
lines.zh: 她把行李交给搬运工并给他看了车票。

lines.en: To her horror he said that she was two hours too soon.
lines.zh: 搬运工说她早到了两个小时，她听后大吃一惊。

lines.en: She felt inhere handbag for the piece of paper on which her father had written down al the details of the journey and gave it to the porter.
lines.zh: 她从钱包里摸出一张纸条，那上面有她父亲对这次旅行详细说明，她把这张纸条交给了搬运工。

lines.en: He agreed that a train did come into the station at the time on the paper and that it did stop, but only to take on mail, not passengers.
lines.zh: 搬运工说，正如纸条所说，确有一趟火车在那个时刻到站，但它只停站装邮件，不载旅客。

lines.en: The girl asked to see a timetable, feeling sure that her father could not have made such a mistake.
lines.zh: 姑娘要求看到时刻表，因为她相信父亲不能把这么大的事弄错。

lines.en: The porter went to fetch one and arrive back with the station master, who produced it with a flourish and pointed out a microscopic 'o' beside the time of the arrival of the train at his station; this little 'o' indicated that the train only stopped for mail.
lines.zh: 搬运工跑回去取时刻表，同时请来了站长。站长拿着时刻表一挥手，指着那趟列车到站时刻旁边一个很小的圆圈标记。这个标记表示列车是为装邮件而停车。

lines.en: Just as that moment the train came into the station.
lines.zh: 正在这时，火车进站了。

lines.en: The girl, tears streaming down her face, begged to be allowed to slip into the guard's van.
lines.zh: 女孩泪流满面，央求让她不声不响地到押车员车厢里去算了。

lines.en: But the station master was adamant : rules could not be broken and she had to watch that train disappear towards her destination while she was left behind.
lines.zh: 但站长态度坚决，规章制度不能破坏，姑娘只得眼看那趟火车消逝在她要去的方向而撇下了她。

questions.q: Why did the young girl miss the train?
questions.zh: 那个小姑娘为什么误了火车？
questions.a: Because the train whose arrival time her father had written down stopped at the station only to take on mail, not passengers, so she could not get on it.
questions.aZh: 因为纸条上那趟车虽在那个时刻到站，却只停站装邮件、不载旅客，所以她上不了车。
questions.hint: 见课文第23句：a train did come...but only to take on mail, not passengers。

questions.q: Why does the writer say punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说准时是文明社会一切公共事务中必需的习惯？
questions.a: Because without it nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion; everything would be in a state of chaos.
questions.aZh: 因为没有准时，什么事情都无法完成，一切都会陷入混乱不堪的境地。

questions.q: What does the writer say about the guest who arrives half an hour too soon?
questions.zh: 作者怎样评价提前半小时到达的客人？
questions.a: Such a guest is the greatest nuisance; the over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual, so they were asked to come half an hour later than the other guests.
questions.aZh: 这样的客人最令人讨厌；到得过早的人和迟到的人同样使人无法忍受，所以作者只好请这些朋友比别的客人晚来半小时。

questions.q: Why did the porter say the girl was two hours too soon?
questions.zh: 搬运工为什么说姑娘早到了两个小时？
questions.a: Because the train listed on her father's paper did stop at that time, but only to take on mail, not passengers.
questions.aZh: 因为纸条上那趟车确实在那个时刻到站停车，但它只停站装邮件，不载旅客。

questions.q: Do you think the station master was right to refuse to let the girl get on? Give your reasons.
questions.zh: 你认为站长拒绝小姑娘上车的做法对吗？请说明理由。
questions.a: I think he was right: rules could not be broken, for one exception would destroy the very order that punctuality depends on. Still, it was hard on a young girl travelling alone for the first time.
questions.aZh: 我认为他是对的：规章制度不能破坏，破一次例就会动摇准时所依赖的秩序；不过对一个第一次独自出门的小姑娘来说，这也太不近人情了。
questions.hint: 结合课文末句 rules could not be broken 谈个人看法。

translation:
准时是文明社会中进行一切社交活动时必须养成的习惯。
不准时将一事无成，事事都会陷入混乱不堪的境地。
只有在人口稀少的农村，才可以忽视准时的习惯。
在日常生活中人们可以容忍一定程度的不准时。
一个专心钻研某个复杂问题的知识分子，为了搞好手头的研究，要把一切都协调一致，组织周密。
因此，他要是赴宴迟到了会得到谅解。
但有些人不准时常常因为掐钟点所致，他们常常受到责备，精力充沛、头脑敏捷的人极不愿意浪费时间，因此他们常想做完一件事后再去赴约。
要是路上没有发生如爆胎、改道、突然起雾等意外事故，他们决不会迟到。
他们与那些从不迟到的人相比，常常是更勤奋有用的公民。
早到的人同迟到的人一样令人讨厌。
客人提前半小时到达是令人讨厌的。
我家有几个朋友就有这有令人恼火的习惯。
唯一的办法就是请他们比别的客人晚来半小时。
这样，他们可以恰好在我们要求的时间到达。
如果赶火车，早到总比晚到好，哪怕早到一会儿也好。
虽然早到可能意味着浪费一点时间，但这比误了火车等上一个多小时坐下班车浪费的时间要少，而且可以避免那种正好在火车驶出站时赶到车站，因上不去车而感到的沮丧。
更难堪的情况是虽然及时赶到站台上，却眼睁睁地看着那趟火车启动，把你抛下。
一个小姑娘第一次单独出门就碰到了这种情况。
在火车进站20分钟前她就进了车站。
因为她的父母再三跟她说，如果误了这趟车，她的东道主朋友就得接她两趟，这是不应该的。
她把行李交给搬运工并给他看了车票。
搬运工说她早到了两个小时，她听后大吃一惊。
她从钱包里摸出一张纸条，那上面有她父亲对这次旅行详细说明，她把这张纸条交给了搬运工。
搬运工说，正如纸条所说，确有一趟火车在那个时刻到站，但它只停站装邮件，不载旅客。
姑娘要求看到时刻表，因为她相信父亲不能把这么大的事弄错。
搬运工跑回去取时刻表，同时请来了站长。
站长拿着时刻表一挥手，指着那趟列车到站时刻旁边一个很小的圆圈标记。
这个标记表示列车是为装邮件而停车。
正在这时，火车进站了。
女孩泪流满面，央求让她不声不响地到押车员车厢里去算了。
但站长态度坚决，规章制度不能破坏，姑娘只得眼看那趟火车消逝在她要去的方向而撇下了她。
title: Too Early and Too Late
subtitle: 太早和太晚

lead.question: 为什么说准时是文明社会的必需习惯？小姑娘明明早到，又为何误了火车？
lead.warmup: 你是否有过“掐着点”出门、最终却错过班车的经历？在文明社会，准时是公共事务得以运转的前提；然而迟到令人厌烦，早到同样让人吃不消。本课从“太早”与“太晚”两个极端切入：一位小姑娘为防迟到提前赶到车站，却因忽略时刻表上一个微小的圆圈标记，眼睁睁看着火车进站又开走，被迫留在站台，实在令人心酸。
goals: 掌握 punctual / punctuality、platform、timetable、anxious、porter、adamant 等本课核心词汇。
理解并运用 only 置于句首引起的倒装句，以及 if / when / though 从句中主语与 be 的省略。
辨析 as much ... as、cut things fine、in good time 等短语，体会作者的对比与讽刺语气。
借助过去完成时 had impressed、虚拟语气 could not have made 与定语从句复述小姑娘误车的故事。
lead.summary: 课文先提出“准时是一切公共事务的必需习惯”，且早到与迟到同样使人难堪；接着以“赶火车宁可早到”作过渡，讲述小姑娘第一次独自出门的经历。她按父亲纸条提前二十分钟进站，却被搬运工告知早到两小时——原来那趟车到站时刻旁的小圆圈只表示停车装邮件、不载旅客。火车进站又开走，站长坚持“规章不能破坏”，她只得留在站台。
lead.tips: 诀窍：记住 as much a trial to others as the unpunctual 这一“as much + 名词 + as”比较结构，译作“和……一样令人难以忍受”；另注意 only 修饰状语置于句首才部分倒装，修饰主语则不倒装。

exercises.q: 汉译英：准时是文明社会中进行一切公共事务时必须养成的习惯。
exercises.a: Punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society.

exercises.q: 句型转换：将 Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it. 改为正常语序。
exercises.a: It is possible to disregard it only in a sparsely-populated rural community.
exercises.note: only 置句首引起部分倒装。

exercises.q: 填空：An even harder situation is to be on the ______ in good time for a train and still to see it go off without you. The girl asked to see a ______, but a tiny 'o' showed the train only stopped for mail.
改错：Her parents had impressed on her that it will be unforgivable to miss the train.
exercises.a: will 改为 would（宾语从句须与主句过去时一致）。
exercises.note: 主句过去时，从句用过去将来时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：姑娘确信父亲不可能犯这样的错误。
exercises.a: The girl felt sure that her father could not have made such a mistake.
exercises.note: could not have done 表对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: 用定语从句合并：Her father had written down all the details on a piece of paper. She felt in her handbag for it.
exercises.a: She felt in her handbag for the piece of paper on which her father had written down all the details of the journey.
exercises.note: 介词 on + which 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: 词形填空：1) The over-______ (punctual) can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual. 2) She was ______ (anxiety) to slip into the guard's van.
exercises.note: anxious=焦虑的；over- 前缀表过度。

quiz.q: 根据课文，准时对文明社会公共事务的重要性体现在哪里？
options: Without it, nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion.
It is only needed in sparsely-populated rural areas.
It can always be disregarded in ordinary living.
It matters only for dinner parties and appointments.

quiz.q: 在人口稀少的农村，人们可以怎样对待准时的习惯？
options: They must be held strictly to it.
It is possible to disregard it.
They can never be late at all.
They have to cut things fine.

quiz.q: 作者怎样看待那些爱“掐钟点”的人？
options: They are always lazy and useless citizens.
They are often more industrious, useful citizens than those who are never late.
They should never be forgiven by others.
They always arrive half an hour early.
quiz.note: 课文第10句表明作者的评价。

quiz.q: 作者家对爱早到的朋友采取了什么办法？
options: They ask them to come half an hour later than the other guests.
They never invite those friends again.
They tell them to come an hour earlier.
They secretly change the time of the party.
quiz.note: 课文第14句 half an hour later。

quiz.q: 搬运工为什么说那小姑娘早到了两个小时？
options: Because the train she wanted only stopped to take on mail, not passengers.
Because her ticket was for another day.
Because the timetable had been changed that day.
Because she had read the wrong platform number.
quiz.note: 那趟车只停站装邮件、不载旅客。

quiz.q: 面对小姑娘的央求，站长最后的态度如何？
options: He let her slip into the guard's van after all.
He was adamant: rules could not be broken.
He gave her a new ticket for the next train.
He offered to drive her to her destination.
quiz.note: 课文末句 was adamant, rules could not be broken。
